ROYAL PAPUA NEW GUINEA CONSTABULARY (RPNGC)

Police Territorial Areas and Administrative Equivalents
POLICE LAYER ADMINISTRATIVE EQUIVALENT TYPICAL SENIOR RANK DOCTRINAL ROLE
Royal Papua New Guinea Constabulary National Police HQ National Level
Commissioner of Police
  • Exercises overall command of the RPNGC
  • Sets national policing direction and priorities
  • Oversees administration and operations
  • Directs national law-and-order strategy
  • Ensures organizational accountability
Deputy Commissioner – Regional Operations National Command Over Territorial Policing
Deputy Commissioner of Police (DCP)
  • Oversees territorial policing nationwide
  • Commands the regional/divisional structure
  • Is also Chief of Specialist Operations
  • Coordinates major regional operations
  • Directs implementation of national operational priorities
  • Supervises Divisional Commanders
Divisional Police Command Regional
Multiple Province Area
Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP)
  • Commands police operations across assigned provinces
  • Supervises Provincial and Metropolitan Commands
  • Coordinates cross-provincial operations
  • Implements national operational directives
  • Monitors regional performance and resources
Provincial Police Command / Metropolitan Police Command Province
National Capital District
Major Metropolitan Area
Chief Superintendent
Superintendent
Chief Inspector
  • Commands policing throughout the province or metropolitan area
  • Supervises police stations and subordinate units
  • Coordinates crime and public-order operations
  • Allocates personnel and operational resources
  • Coordinates with provincial and local authorities
Police Station District
Sub-district
Town

  • Conducts day-to-day local policing
  • Responds to crimes and incidents
  • Manages local police operations and patrols
  • Maintains public order
